Technical (chapter.md): Loop D Try/Observe: 20 guardrails under H0 → 64% of runs trigger a false alarm naively; Bonferroni (0.05/20) ≈ 5%. Image images/guardrails.png.

Topic: Hierarchical Bayes with partial pooling
Story (story.md): Treat metric lifts as draws from a population; shrinkage pulls noisy lifts toward zero; more candidates → more regularization. Forward-referenced to segmentation/hierarchical chapters.
Technical (chapter.md): Loop D Compare: PyMC sketch — tau_lift ~ HalfNormal, mu_lift ~ Normal(0,.), lift_i ~ Normal(mu_lift, tau_lift), metric_i ~ Normal(lift_i, sigma_i). Hyperprior on tau_lift does the work. Image images/hierarchical_shrinkage.png.
